runner.intro:
Session C00:00

Week 1 · Wednesday, October 28

Foundation Strength B (Hinge & Pull)

10exercises
19sets
+40XP
  1. 1Warm-up5 minutes of rowing machine or brisk incline walking
  2. 2Warm-up10 bodyweight hip hinges and 10 shoulder dislocations with a towel or band
  3. 3Warm-up1 light warm-up set of Romanian deadlifts
  4. 4Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift3 sets × 8-12 reps — Hinge hips backward with a flat spine until you feel a moderate hamstring stretch.
  5. 5Seated Cable Row or Supported Dumbbell Row3 sets × 8-12 reps — Pull handles toward your lower abdomen and pause while keeping your torso quiet.
  6. 6Dumbbell or Machine Overhead Shoulder Press3 sets × 8-12 reps — Press vertically without hyperextending your lumbar spine; brace your midsection.
  7. 7Dumbbell Reverse Lunge or Step-Up3 sets × 8-10 reps per leg — Step backward under control, gently touch back knee to the floor, and push through front heel.
  8. 8Dead Bug Core Alternation2 sets × 10 reps per side — Press your lower back into the mat as opposite arm and leg extend outward.
  9. 9Cool-downKneeling hip flexor stretch for 40 seconds per side
  10. 10Cool-downCat-cow spinal mobility for 8 repetitions

Every set you log is saved to your plan.
